objective: Measure local hypoxic-water availability and vertical structure directly rather than infer Eastern Shore bottom state from regional proxies.

deployment_geometry.minimum: one near-bottom package mounted above sediment and below the usual surface mixed layer
deployment_geometry.preferred: paired near-surface and near-bottom packages or one bottom package plus a repeatable vertical profile
deployment_geometry.reason: Jubilee physics depends on oxygen-poor saline bottom water and vertical stratification; a single surface sensor cannot resolve that state.

sampling.burst_option: temporarily increase cadence during high-risk predawn windows if supported by hardware
sampling.clock: UTC internally; preserve observed_at separately from available_at and ingested_at

qa_qc.calibration: manufacturer calibration plus pre-deployment verification and post-deployment check
qa_qc.biofouling: anti-fouling design plus scheduled inspection/cleaning; fouling periods explicitly flagged
qa_qc.maintenance_target: initially inspect at least every 2-4 weeks during warm season, then adapt from observed fouling/drift
qa_qc.reference_basis: NOAA/IOOS dissolved-oxygen QA/QC guidance and NERRS SWMP continuous-monitoring practice

power_telemetry.preferred: shore-powered at pier with local buffering plus network upload
power_telemetry.fail_safe: retain measurements locally through network outages and upload later without rewriting observed_at

guardrails: No production weight until sensor provenance/QC are passing and out-of-sample incremental value is demonstrated.
Do not substitute this site measurement for Point Clear or other shoreline cells without an explicitly tested spatial-transfer model.
Preserve raw immutable observations and calibration/maintenance records.
